# Menu artwork

`menu-keyart.png` was generated with the built-in image generation tool for this game.

Prompt:

Create a premium cinematic key art background for an arcade racing game menu, landscape 16:9. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI. A highly detailed unbranded graphite black sports coupe with glowing icy cyan headlights and subtle lime racing accents, parked at a low three-quarter front angle on wet asphalt on a coastal mountain road at blue hour, neon city skyline far across the bay on the right, sunset peach sliver on horizon, tire rubber and wet road reflections, photoreal AAA game promotional rendering, strong dark navy shadows. Composition: main car occupies right-center, from 45% to 88% width, mostly within middle 60% height; left third is restrained dark negative space for a menu title. Sophisticated atmospheric volumetric lighting, cool silver body reflections, cinematic depth, realistic materials and crisp car details. No people. Asset intended as a static game title screen background.

The menu uses bundled Barlow Condensed and DM Sans fonts from Google Fonts, under the SIL Open Font License. License copies are in `fonts/`.
